name: Savant
ability: Each day, you may visit the Storyteller to learn 2 things in private: 1 is true & 1 is false.
wakes: Never at night. Each day the Savant may request one private visit.
interaction: The Storyteller gives two statements, one true and one false, in an order that does not reveal which is which. The Savant chooses nothing.
drunk_or_poisoned: Both statements may be true, or both false.

rulings.text: The Savant initiates the visit; the Storyteller does not offer it, and the Savant may skip any day.
At most one visit per day.
A drunk or poisoned Savant gets two true or two false statements.
Information should be relevant and should avoid naming the Demon outright; the Storyteller may ask the Savant to come back later.

test_scenarios.name: one true one false
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Savant, Bob Imp, Carol Poisoner, Dave Chef.
test_scenarios.expected: Alice receives two statements, e.g. 'Carol is a Minion' (true) and 'Dave is evil' (false).

test_scenarios.name: skip a day
test_scenarios.actions: Day 1: Alice does not visit; Day 2: Alice visits.
test_scenarios.expected: No info on day 1; one pair of statements on day 2.

test_scenarios.name: poisoned savant
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Savant poisoned by Carol Poisoner; Bob Imp.
test_scenarios.expected: Storyteller may give two false statements (or two true).

test_scenarios.name: drunk savant
test_scenarios.setup: Eve is the Drunk believing she is the Savant.
test_scenarios.expected: Statements need not be one true and one false.
